app.name: Scenes
app.summary: Scenes as tiles on a gradient of their own colours: first the room, then the scene.
app.colors_hint: Empty: the colours of the scene (from the Hue bridge) or of the light. Otherwise up to three colours as #RRGGBB, separated by commas: #3848FE, #FE6EBC.
app.room_hint: The room as the Hue app names it. Below it only the scenes of this room.
app.scene_hint: A scene of the chosen room. A tap on the tile starts it.
